author: Betty Reilly
text: Kris is a very honest Septic Sewer Inspector who does an inspection based on digging a proper core sample to find out the viability of your Septic System. Kris does not give you an answer based on the age of your Septic System without doing a thorough inspection first.  I highly recommend Kris!

author: Pete
text: This company responded within one day to help diagnose and repair our commercial septic system. Others could not do any better than a two week delay.  They also offered advice on how to make the system work better.  Very honest and knowledgeable.

author: John Maher
text:
Kris of KT Septic Inspections came out to inspect my septic system on a farm house that was later in the day discovered to have been built in 1837 and remodeled in 1975.  Kris was very professional,  knowledgeable and shared his information very clearly in layman's terms so that you could understand what he discovered.  He if fact discovered several issues with a very old out dated septic system that most likely needed to have the health department come out and do a full perk test of the drain field. He advised the tank needed pump out and discovered it had roots growing into the tanks.  He also advised myself and my Real Estate agent on many other factors related to what needed to be done to up grade the system to full code.

Thank you kris, nice job!!

author: Kelly Williams
text: Highly recommend! Kris has done my septic inspection for the city twice now, and he's continuously gone above and beyond to deliver outstanding service. 👍 …
